title: MusicWheel
description: This mod adds cool music selection wheel + music controller for various events
body:
**Meet the MusicWheel mod!**

- This mod fulfills its function - it adds a **music wheel** (just like Fortnite emotes wheel), and now YOU can choose which music will play!

- This mod also has music options for menu, game and events (in the mod settings)

- English and Russian localizations are supported
